acceptance_tests.given: a keep_push ref whose commit range both adds a path absent from baseline and deletes a path present on baseline
acceptance_tests.must_not: cherry-pick the whole ref or apply the baseline delete
acceptance_tests.then: only the path-absent allowlisted paths appear on the extract branch

beneficiary_fit.compatibility_risk: Extract self-test currently asserts cherry-pick of identical patches; hardening must not weaken patch-id diagnosis.
beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: Replace whole-ref cherry-pick with path-union through the allowlist; keep cherry-pick only when the diagnosis receipt proves the range is path-limited and add-only.

concepts.description: For diagnosed keep_push and preserve refs, extract the union of paths that pass the allowlist versus the fetched baseline. Do not cherry-pick the whole branch.
concepts.name: Path-union extract, never whole-branch cherry-pick
concepts.problem: Cherry-picking a mixed leftover ref copies deletes and overwrites of names already on the baseline.
risks: A remaining cherry-pick path that is not add-only reintroduces baseline deletes.
Unknown whether this needs a new script or workflow-only hardening.
concepts.semantic_contract: Extract leftover committed work by path-union against the fetched baseline through the allowlist. Whole-branch cherry-pick is forbidden when the range touches a path already on baseline.

acceptance_tests.given: a unique blob whose bytes do not appear on baseline but whose path already exists at baseline
acceptance_tests.must_not: overwrite the baseline path because the blob looks novel
acceptance_tests.then: the path is skipped as already on baseline

acceptance_tests.given: a unique blob on a keep_push tip at a path that fails cat-file on baseline
acceptance_tests.must_not: ignore committed leftover trees solely because porcelain is clean
acceptance_tests.then: that path is eligible to copy

concepts.beneficiary_destination: skills/l9-git-work-preserve/scripts/harvest_worktree_dirt.py classify_path plus extract of diagnosed leftover trees

beneficiary_fit.compatibility_risk: Classifier remains report-only; extract must consume the same predicate.
beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: Keep porcelain cat-file skip; extend the same path-absent rule to unique committed paths on diagnosed leftover refs.

concepts.description: Copy a path only when git cat-file -e baseline:path fails. Path-absent, not blob-absent-only. Apply to porcelain dirt and to unique committed paths on diagnosed leftover refs.
concepts.name: Copy iff path absent on baseline
concepts.problem: Copying a blob onto a path that already exists on baseline overwrites landed work; copying by blob identity duplicates a file later added under a new name.
risks: Extending cat-file to keep_push trees without an allowlist would copy foreign-layout or generated paths.
Blob-absent checks would duplicate renamed landings.
concepts.semantic_contract: A path is copy-eligible only when it is absent from the fetched baseline tree. Novelty of blob content without path absence is not copy authority.

acceptance_tests.given: classifier output whose unique copy set is empty
acceptance_tests.must_not: treat empty unique as failure or copy skipped paths
acceptance_tests.then: extract stops successfully and copies nothing

acceptance_tests.given: an allowlist with copy and skip rows each carrying a reason
acceptance_tests.must_not: copy a skipped path because it appeared in harvestable earlier
acceptance_tests.then: only copy-set paths are copied

beneficiary_fit.compatibility_risk: JSON schema for the allowlist does not exist yet and must not encode donor filenames.
beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: Keep classifier lists as input; require an allowlist artifact with reasons and empty-stop before extract mutates.

concepts.description: Emit a copy/skip/reason allowlist artifact. Extract consumes only the copy set. Empty copy set is a valid stop.
concepts.name: Durable copy/skip allowlist; empty copy set is stop
concepts.problem: A live classifier dump is not a gate: skip reasons vanish, and an empty unique set is treated as failure instead of success.
risks: An allowlist that lists paths without reasons becomes an un-auditable copy list.
Mutating extract before the allowlist exists recreates scooping.
concepts.semantic_contract: Extract may copy only paths in a durable allowlist copy set. Each skip has a reason. An empty copy set is success, not a defect.

acceptance_tests.given: a dirty file whose path exists on baseline and whose diff deletes a line that still exists on baseline
acceptance_tests.must_not: overwrite or delete any baseline line
acceptance_tests.then: the path is skipped

acceptance_tests.given: a dirty file whose path exists on baseline and whose diff adds lines and deletes zero baseline-still-present lines
acceptance_tests.must_not: rewrite the baseline file wholesale
acceptance_tests.then: only the added lines may be appended
acceptance_tests.when: extract is allowed the add-only exception

beneficiary_fit.compatibility_risk: False add-only proofs would regress protected root files.
beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: Keep default skip; add an explicit add-only exception with a proof that no still-present baseline line is deleted.

concepts.description: Default skip dirty-on-baseline. Copy unique added lines only when the worktree diff deletes zero lines that still exist on baseline.
concepts.name: Add-only exception for dirty-on-baseline paths
concepts.problem: A hard skip of every path that exists on baseline drops unique added lines; overwriting that path regresses landed wording.
risks: A naive line-in-file check can false-positive on coincidental shared lines.
Protected additive_only roots still need append-only plus marker rules.
concepts.semantic_contract: Dirty-on-baseline defaults to skip. The only exception is an add-only diff: zero deletions of lines that still exist on baseline, applied as append, never wholesale overwrite.

acceptance_tests.given: a unique path whose first directory is absent from the fetched baseline tree layout
acceptance_tests.must_not: copy it because it is path-absent
acceptance_tests.then: the path is skipped as foreign overlay

acceptance_tests.given: a unique path matching the live generated-prefix SSOT
acceptance_tests.must_not: copy the stale generated file from a behind tree
acceptance_tests.then: the path is skipped and later regen may recreate it from copied sources

concepts.beneficiary_destination: skills/l9-git-work-preserve harvest classifier declarative prefix/generated/secret config

beneficiary_fit.compatibility_risk: A second generated-prefix list would drift from GENERATED_PATH_PREFIXES.
beneficiary_fit.existing_owner: harvest skip_noise/wiring_noise only; generated skip lives in harvest-workflow prose plus sync_generated_artifacts.py
beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: Configure prefix/generated/secret skip from live SSOTs; do not encode donor product-tree names.

concepts.description: Copy only prefixes the fetched baseline tree uses. Skip generated prefixes owned by the regen SSOT, secret globs, and trees absent from baseline layout. Prefix lists are configuration, not donor path literals.
concepts.name: Copy only layout-native prefixes
concepts.problem: Unique paths from another product layout, generated prefixes, or secret globs look harvestable if the only test is path-absent.
risks: Baking a donor product-tree name list into the skill would fail on the next layout.
Generated skip must follow GENERATED_PATH_PREFIXES, not a parallel list.
concepts.semantic_contract: Copy eligibility requires the path prefix to be part of the baseline layout, not generated, and not secret. Foreign overlay means a prefix the baseline tree does not use.

acceptance_tests.given: a dangling blob with no recoverable path name
acceptance_tests.must_not: write it to a guessed path on the extract branch
acceptance_tests.then: the blob is left dangling

acceptance_tests.given: a dangling blob whose recovered path fails the allowlist
acceptance_tests.must_not: copy it because the object is unique
acceptance_tests.then: the blob is left dangling

beneficiary_fit.compatibility_risk: Lost-found naming is git-implementation incidental; recover must use the path, not the lost-found filename.
beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: Add optional recover behind the same allowlist; default leave dangling.

concepts.description: Recover a dangling blob only when a path name exists and that path passes the allowlist. Unnamed dangling objects stay dangling.
concepts.name: Recover dangling objects only when named and allowlisted
concepts.problem: Lost objects without a path cannot be proven unique-and-layout-native, so recovering them risks silent overwrites.
risks: fsck lost-found names can be incomplete; unnamed recover is unsafe.
Pack has no dangling recover path today; adding one without the allowlist would bypass classify.
concepts.semantic_contract: Dangling recover requires both a path name and allowlist membership. Object uniqueness without a path is not copy authority.

acceptance_tests.given: a unique path that harvest intends to remove from the donor location
acceptance_tests.must_not: delete the unique path while it is the only copy
acceptance_tests.then: a committed copy already exists at the destination path

beneficiary_fit.compatibility_risk: Source worktrees staying intact already preserves bytes; the new rule is about planned path deletes, not worktree deletes.
beneficiary_fit.existing_owner: harvest-workflow leave source worktrees intact; no bytes-before-delete rule
beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: Add the preserve-before-delete gate for unique_plans/unique_wip moves; do not import donor shelf filenames.

concepts.description: Do not drop a unique path until a committed copy exists at the intended destination path.
concepts.name: Committed copy before unique-path delete
concepts.problem: Deleting or shelving a unique path before a committed copy exists at the destination loses the only bytes.
risks: Shelf-layout destination paths are beneficiary-specific and must not import donor filenames.
This is adjacent to plans-store shelf rules; keep harvest from owning shelf taxonomy.
concepts.semantic_contract: A unique path may be removed from a donor location only after a committed copy exists at the destination. Absence of that copy blocks delete.

acceptance_tests.given: harvestable unique_plans and unrelated unique_product paths
acceptance_tests.must_not: mix the themes in one PR or stack onto an unrelated open PR
acceptance_tests.then: they land on separate PRs on the default stack and none are merged by harvest

beneficiary_fit.compatibility_risk: Push authorization stays on the surface profile, not this skill.
beneficiary_fit.existing_owner: harvest-workflow Publish: one theme per PR, no unrelated stack, overlap block
beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: Fold default-stack and no-merge into Publish. Do not encode a theme count.

concepts.description: Publish leftover themes as separate PRs on the default stack. Do not mix unique_product themes. Do not merge from harvest.
concepts.name: One theme per PR on the stack, no merge
concepts.problem: Mixing leftover themes in one PR and stacking onto an unrelated open PR hides review and collides overlap.
risks: A numeric theme count is donor-incidental and must not become a skill quota.
PR_STACK=auto is already the repo default; restating it as harvest-only would fork publish doctrine.
concepts.semantic_contract: Each leftover theme publishes as its own PR on the default stack. Harvest does not merge. Unrelated open PRs are not harvest stack parents.

acceptance_tests.given: a leftover ref still classified keep_push after extract
acceptance_tests.must_not: delete keep_push or content_superset refs
acceptance_tests.then: the ref is kept

acceptance_tests.given: unique paths have not yet been extracted
acceptance_tests.must_not: delete a ref whose unique paths are not yet on an extract branch
acceptance_tests.then: prune is refused

beneficiary_fit.compatibility_risk: Do not let harvest own stash-drop; that stays stash-deep-analysis.
beneficiary_fit.existing_owner: prune-policy patch_id split plus SKILL extract-then-prune order
beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: Keep existing delete classes; add explicit re-diagnose after extract and refuse prune until extract receipts exist for unique paths.

concepts.description: Re-diagnose after extract. prune-execute only prune_candidate or archive_ref with patch_id. keep_push and content_superset remain. Stashes are not dropped.
concepts.name: Prune last; patch-id only; keep keep_push
concepts.problem: Pruning leftover refs before unique paths are extracted deletes the only SHA of unlanded work; content_superset deletes are false absorption.
risks: Re-diagnose skipped after extract would prune a ref whose unique path was just copied but whose leftover sibling path was not.
keep_push is already a non-prune class; duplicating that as a new rule creates two owners.
concepts.semantic_contract: Prune-execute runs only after extract and a fresh diagnosis. Eligible classes are prune_candidate and archive_ref with patch_id. keep_push and content_superset are never deleted by this path.

acceptance_tests.given: a leftover tree containing both a unique source and a generated manifest
acceptance_tests.must_not: copy the leftover generated manifest
acceptance_tests.then: the source may copy and generated files are regenerated from the SSOT if needed

beneficiary_fit.compatibility_risk: None if prefixes stay owned by sync_generated_artifacts.py.
beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: Keep existing regen-not-copy rule; do not add a second generated list.

concepts.description: If copied sources require regen, run the generated-artifact SSOT. Do not copy generated files from leftover trees.
concepts.name: Regen generated artifacts; never copy stale generated
concepts.problem: Generated files from a behind tree overwrite current hashes and manifests.
risks: A parallel generated-prefix list would drift.
concepts.semantic_contract: Generated artifacts are regenerated from copied sources via the existing SSOT. Leftover generated files are never copy sources.

acceptance_tests.given: a dirty shared primary checkout and leftover unique paths
acceptance_tests.must_not: stage, checkout, or apply on the shared dirty clone, or apply a behind-baseline dirty tree wholesale
acceptance_tests.then: copies land on a dedicated worktree started from fetched baseline

beneficiary_fit.compatibility_risk: None if rule 49 remains the isolation owner.
beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: Keep existing execute path; treat donor as confirming evidence.

concepts.description: Extract onto a dedicated worktree from fetched baseline. Never scoop the dirty shared clone. Never apply a behind-baseline dirty tree wholesale.
concepts.name: Dedicated baseline worktree; never scoop shared dirty clone
concepts.problem: Applying leftover dirt on the shared primary clone overwrites other agents' work and can replay stale baseline hunks.
risks: Restating rule 49 inside harvest would duplicate worktree isolation.
concepts.semantic_contract: Leftover extract mutates only a dedicated worktree from fetched baseline. Shared dirty clones and wholesale stale-tree applies are forbidden.

acceptance_tests.given: this harvest
acceptance_tests.must_not: add bak-clone skip lists to l9-git-work-preserve
acceptance_tests.then: SSOT/bak skip stays local to this machine's clone map

beneficiary_fit.compatibility_risk: Importing bak skip would mix repo-sync ownership into harvest.
beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: Keep local. git-work-preserve harvests sibling worktrees of the named repo, not clone-map selection.

concepts.description: Live SSOT and backup clones are not harvest sources unless a path is absent from the workspace extract.
concepts.name: Skip live SSOT and bak clones unless path missing from workspace extract
concepts.problem: A second governance clone can look like leftover unique work.
risks: Clone-map already owns ssot vs workspace selection.

concepts.name: Plan-build as push authorization

drift.behavior: Porcelain harvest classifies dirty/untracked paths with cat-file against baseline, but does not scan unique committed paths on keep_push or preserve tips.
drift.canonical_candidate: path-absent copy applied to diagnosed ref trees as well as porcelain
drift.resolution: Donor is stronger on committed leftover trees; beneficiary already owns the porcelain case.

drift.behavior: Extract workflow still allows cherry-pick of a whole diagnosed ref; donor forbids whole-branch cherry-pick because mixed refs carry baseline overwrites and deletes.
drift.resolution: Port path-union; keep cherry-pick only when the diagnosis receipt proves the commit range is path-limited and add-only.

drift.behavior: already_on_baseline is a hard skip; donor allows an add-only exception when the dirty diff deletes zero lines that still exist on baseline.
drift.canonical_candidate: default skip with explicit add-only exception
drift.resolution: Port the exception as hardening, not as a default overwrite.

evidence.claim: Success property: harvested path fails git cat-file -e baseline:path before copy and exists on the extract branch after.
Copy iff unique class or cat-file fails on a keep_push/dangling blob, prefix is layout-native, not generated, not additive_only overwrite, not foreign overlay, and not a wholesale stale apply.
Require path-absent, not blob-absent-only: a blob later landed under a new name would duplicate if copied by content identity.
Emit allowlist JSON of paths to copy or skip with reason. Empty copy set is a valid stop.
Overlapping unique paths on keep_push tips extract by path union vs baseline, not by cherry-picking whole branches.
Default skip dirty-on-baseline. Append-only unique lines only if the worktree diff deletes zero lines that still exist on baseline.
Copy only this-repo prefixes; skip generated prefixes, secret globs, and trees the baseline layout does not use.
Recover dangling blobs only when named and allowlisted; unnamed dangling objects stay dangling.
Preserve unique plan bytes before any root delete of that path.
Do not mix unique_product themes in one PR; stack via PR_STACK=auto; do not stack onto unrelated open PRs.
Prune-execute only after extract; re-diagnose; delete prune_candidate and archive_ref with patch_id only; keep keep_push and content_superset; do not drop stashes.
Regenerate generated artifacts from copied sources; do not copy stale generated files.
Extract uses a dedicated worktree as an execution step, not a planning lock; do not harvest onto the dirty shared branch.
Skip live SSOT and bak clones unless a path is missing from the workspace extract.
Donor states that building this plan is push authorization for those make pr invocations.
Named kernel files, commit SHAs, and a numeric theme count are instances of path-absent copy and path-union, not transferable contracts.
Classifier returns already_on_baseline when git cat-file -e baseline:rel succeeds.
Harvest class already_on_baseline means path exists at baseline and is not harvested.
Harvest inspects git status porcelain untracked-all only; it does not walk committed trees of keep_push tips.
Extract workflow says cherry-pick or path-limited commits onto the new branch and keeps this file as the one-ref cherry-pick path.
Harvest execute: dedicated origin/main worktree, unique_* pathspecs only, regen generated artifacts, never copy stale generated files, never scoop the shared clone.
Publish forbids mixing unrelated unique_product themes and stacking this harvest onto an unrelated open PR. PR_STACK=auto is not named.
archive_ref prune requires redundancy_basis patch_id; content_superset never authorises a delete.
Compact workflow: harvest or extract first on a fresh origin/main worktree; prune-execute last and auth-gated.
Generated path prefixes are owned by sync_generated_artifacts.py, not by donor path literals.
Whether path-union should be a new script or extract-workflow prose only is unobserved.

inventory.purpose: Donor execution plan stating leftover-work no-regression invariants: classify, allowlist, path-union extract, themed publish, prune-last.

safety.claim: Donor plan was inventoried and read, not executed. No harvest/extract/prune scripts were run against leftover refs.
No files under skills/l9-git-work-preserve were created or edited.
Donor kernel filenames, plan filenames, SHAs, branch names, and census counts were classified REJECT, not PORT.
Secret globs and Legal Defense paths were not copied into transferable contracts.

source_identity.note: Untracked plan at inventory time; no git blob sha.

control_flow.relation: gates copy set; empty is stop

system.identity: A leftover-work remainder system: reclassify unique bytes against a fetched baseline, emit a copy/skip allowlist, port only path-absent layout-native paths onto a dedicated baseline worktree, publish by theme, then prune only patch-id-absorbed refs.
must_not_own: donor census counts, SHAs, branch names, and named file lists
live SSOT vs bak clone selection

ownership_boundaries.owns: porcelain dirty/untracked path classes vs baseline
one-ref local extract; currently cherry-pick or path-limited commits
delete authority: prune_candidate and archive_ref with patch_id only
in-place catch-up and parking of unique work; does not harvest or prune
transfer semantics and acceptance tests only; no skill mutation

steps: re-inventory and re-diagnose vs fetched baseline
emit copy/skip/reason allowlist; stop if copy set empty
spawn dedicated worktree from fetched baseline
copy path-union of unique paths through the allowlist
regen generated artifacts from copied sources only
publish one theme per PR on the stack; no merge
re-diagnose; prune-execute patch-id absorbed refs last
